title: No ready state (compute or checklist faults)
sourceDocs: DTP TS tickets via Glean, Aug–Oct 2026

cr_safe.help: Don't troubleshoot while driving. Park per SOP first. A cold start may be needed.

cr_checks.text: What do the failing checklists point to?

cr_seat.text: Latch the seat belt, then retry ready state
steps: Be seated with the driver's seat belt latched before requesting ready state.
Retry ready state.

cr_lte.text: Cycle the Peplink, if that's a VO task where you are
steps: Power-cycle the Peplink per SOP.
Wait for the LTE checklist to clear, then retry ready state.
cr_lte.caution: Only if Peplink cycling is an operator task in your SOP. If not, choose 'I can't do this step'.

cr_loopq.text: Have you driven a loop since the last cold start?
cr_loopq.help: A VRE reminder from DTP-109224: after any cold start, drive a loop so localization can recover.

steps: Drive the approved loop in manual per SOP.
Watch whether the pose checklists clear.

cr_atlas.text: Check the atlas setting on the VO ticket
steps: Confirm the ticket's Atlas view matches where the truck physically is.
If it doesn't, it needs fixing before anything else will work. Note it for the VRE.
cr_atlas.help: In DTP-112429 the ticket pointed at the wrong region's atlas, so the truck couldn't localize and cold starts didn't help.

cr_pbt.text: Do the PBT reset the tool is asking for
steps: Perform the PBT reset per SOP.
Retry ready state or the launch step.

cr_cs.text: Cold start and retry ready state
steps: TODO: platform cold-start sequence from SOP.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
If pose checklists remain, drive a loop before calling it failed.
If TApp tasks didn't reset after the cold start, a VRE has to reset them.
Retry ready state.
cr_cs.source: TS: DTP-112093, DTP-112431, DTP-109224 · VO site practice (Oct 2026)

steps: Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Apply parking brake.
Press and hold the Compute Power Button for 5 seconds. PWR indicators blink red.
Wait for both PWR indicators to slow-blink green.
Press and hold the Engine Start Button to turn off the vehicle.
Turn the primary battery bank switch OFF.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch OFF.
Ensure both TMS LEDs are off. If on, cycle the battery switches again.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes.
Ensure the DBW Disconnect is in the up/released position.
Turn the redundant (secondary) battery bank switch ON.
Connect shore power if needed.
Turn the primary battery bank switch ON.
Shore power only: press Engine Start twice. Vehicle power: hold the Engine Start Button.
Ensure both TMS LEDs show amber or green.
Press the drive height recall button.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. It fast-blinks green, then goes steady.
If it takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Turn ignition key OFF. The LED stays solid green for about 150 seconds, flashes red for about 10 seconds, then turns off.
Wait a minimum of 3 minutes after the LED is off.
Perform System Start Up.
Ensure the DBW Cutoff Switch is in the up/released position.
Engine power: start the engine and keep the ignition key in ON.
Shore power: confirm the shore power switch is off, connect shore power to the vehicle DC receptacle, turn the shore power switch on, then turn the ignition key to ON.
Ensure the Compute Power Button is flashing once per second (system ready to boot).
Press and release the Compute Power Button. The LED fast-blinks green, then burns steadily.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.
Perform System Shut Down.
Apply parking brake and place transmission in Neutral.
Swap stack to idle via TAPP or Scout.
Turn ignition key OFF.
If on shore power: turn the shore power unit switch OFF and disconnect shore power from the vehicle.
Wait a minimum of 2 minutes.
Perform System Start Up.
Press the DBW Disconnect switch.
Start the engine. If on shore power: plug in shore power and turn the key to ON for 5 seconds.
Immediately release the DBW Disconnect button and ensure it is in the up/released position.
Wait for both PWR indicators on the LSI to slow-blink green.
Press the Compute Power Button for 1 second. PWR indicators fast-blink green, then burn steadily.
If the system takes more than 10 minutes to boot, consult VRE.
FG2.1 only: perform the TBS check.
Swap to AV stack via TAPP or Scout.
Wait for the truck to reconnect to the tool before doing anything else.

cr_cs.help: Most no-ready-state tickets cleared after a cold start (DTP-112093, DTP-112431, DTP-106551, DTP-105363, DTP-111299).

cr_resolved.text: Ready state reached. Continue the mission.

cr_esc.text: Operator-level ready-state steps are used up. Open a TS ticket and paste the handoff.
cr_esc.handoffNote: From past tickets: faults that survive repeated cold starts usually point to hardware (BMC, disks, GNSS, safety core, radar defect) and end in service hold or a truck pivot. 'Hotstart detected' after a cold start means the cold boot failed and needs another (DTP-112726).

cr_cs2.text: Cold start once more and retry
cr_cs2.help: Several tickets needed a second cold start: hotstart detected after the first, or pose/GNSS not back yet (DTP-112726, DTP-109224, DTP-105672, DTP-112417).
